Africa, by the numbers

A continent
of opportunity.

Africa holds world-class renewable energy resources, a young and growing population, and the critical minerals needed for the global energy transition. The challenge is not potential — it’s unlocking the investment, infrastructure and policy to scale it.

“

Africa’s energy transition is not a question of if, but how fast we can scale it.

Wangari MuchiriFounder & CEO, RE.Think Energy

Explore Our Work
How we work

From ideas to
a brighter Africa.

We turn ambitious ideas into investable projects, enabling policies, innovative solutions and local value chains — accelerating a just and inclusive energy transition across Africa.

01
Build the PipelineProject Incubation & Demand Aggregation

We identify and de-risk renewable energy projects and aggregate demand — turning opportunities into investment-ready portfolios.

02
Enable the SystemR&D: Battery Storage, AI & Smart Grids

We test and pilot technologies that make Africa’s energy systems more flexible, reliable and responsive — from battery storage to AI-enabled grid intelligence.

03
Remove the BarriersPolicy & Capacity Building

We work with governments, regulators and institutions to translate energy ambitions into practical frameworks that enable investment and implementation.

04
Localise ValueSupply Chain Localization & Manufacturing

We connect opportunities across the energy value chain to support local manufacturing, component assembly and stronger regional supply chains.
